win_claim.quote: The experimental results show that our cluster-based under-sampling approaches outperform the other under-sampling techniques in the previous studies.

uncertain: Proposed method taken as SBC (named in abstract/conclusion as best); SBCMD also highlighted in conclusion for noisy data (p.9).
best_other chosen among external baselines AT/RT/NearMiss-2 only; proposed variant SBCMF has 59.04 in Table 4 (p.8).
Census-Income how_obtained set 'original' although authors removed incomplete records (p.8); could be read as 'modified'.
Overdue Detection n_instances/n_minority/n_majority are training-set counts; separate test set of 63,532 (p.9).
Synthetic datasets: n_classes not explicitly printed (two groups/classes per cluster, p.4); number of attributes printed as 5 numerical + 5 categorical, left n_features null (p.6).
notes: Under-sampling paper (SBC = under-sampling based on clustering). Proposed variants: SBC, SBCNM-1, SBCNM-2, SBCNM-3, SBCMD, SBCMF. Metrics: MI's precision, recall, F-measure (plus MA's for Census). No G-mean or AUC reported. Only Census-Income has numeric per-method table (Table 4, text-extractable, verified against rendered page 8). Synthetic results (Figs. 4-8) and Overdue Detection (Fig. 11) are bar/line plots only, no printed numbers. Execution times in Figs. 9, 10, 12. Paper refers to 'two real datasets'; number of synthetic datasets not stated. Classifier is a single ANN throughout; clustering by k-means. Table 4 other values (MI's F-measure): RT 46.47, AT 51.9, SBCNM-1 45.28, SBCNM-2 45.64, SBCNM-3 44.61, SBCMD 44.94, SBCMF 59.04.
